::: {#rem-hamiltonian-hard}
#### No simple test for Hamiltonian cycles

@thm-euler-circuit decides whether a connected graph has an Euler circuit by looking at its degrees,
which takes one pass through an adjacency list.
No test like that is known for Hamiltonian cycles (@def-hamiltonian-cycle).
Deciding whether a graph has one is an NP-complete problem [@wikipedia_hamiltonian_path_problem]:
no algorithm is known that decides it in a number of steps bounded by a polynomial in the number of vertices.

:::
